description: Managing the outgoing data streams (telemetry, logs, errors, events, user streams) and their bindings to transports (UART, BLE).

commands.label: Create a stream
commands.description: Creates a user stream with the given ID and stream byte.

fields.label: Connector ID
fields.description: Connector ID (4 or more for the app's streams)

fields.label: Stream byte
fields.description: Byte that identifies the stream in a frame

fields.label: Stream name
fields.description: Name for diagnostics (text, NUL-terminated, runs to the end of the frame)

commands.label: Remove a stream
commands.description: Removes a user stream and its bindings to transports.

fields.label: Connector ID
fields.description: ID of the connector to remove

commands.label: Bind to a transport
commands.description: Binds a stream to a transport (UART, BLE) at the given endpoint.

fields.label: Endpoint
fields.description: Endpoint of the transport (for BLE the 16-bit UUID of the characteristic, for UART 0)

commands.label: Remove a binding
commands.description: Removes the binding of a stream to the given transport.

commands.label: Suspend a stream
commands.description: Stops sending frames on a stream (they are dropped without blocking the sender).

fields.label: Connector ID
fields.description: ID of the connector to suspend

commands.label: Resume a stream
commands.description: Resumes normal sending on a suspended stream.

fields.label: Connector ID
fields.description: ID of the connector to resume

commands.label: List the streams
commands.description: Returns every active connector, its state (system, suspended) and its transport bindings.

returns.label: Number of connectors
returns.description: Then, for each connector: id, stream, flags (bit 0 system, bit 1 suspended), number of bindings and the bindings (provider, endpoint), a NUL-terminated name.
